value.answer: Drooling, chewing on everything and being fussy is very often teething in a toddler - first molars usually come in around 13 to 19 months. Cold (not frozen) teething toys can help. Teething usually doesn't cause fever, real crying, vomiting or diarrhea, so those point to something else.
value.triage: Call 811 if there's a fever, real crying, vomiting, diarrhea, refusing to eat or drink, or it's getting worse. Go to the ER or call 911 now if your child looks very sick, is hard to wake, or is struggling to breathe.
